text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day off, while visiting a park—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Tooooohhh!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Kgh, I need to be faster, cooler...
But what on earth am I supposed to do...?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa there!? You startled me!
I thought you were a villain for a second!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... Whatever, fine, I'll explain it to you!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: To tell you the truth... I was just practicing my special move for the next race!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: A special move that seizes upon the opponent's opening to unleash an explosive burst of speed...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—Known as...
the "Pegasus Mach Strike"!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...But there's no time until the next race,
so I've gotta hurry!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: That's why I train even on my days off—to master the 'Pegasus Mach Strike'!
choice_data_list: Getting a strike sounds pretty cool.
Getting a strike sounds pretty cool.
It's best not to do anything reckless.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: That's why I train even on my days off—to master the 'Pegasus Mach Strike'!
choice_data_list: Getting a strike sounds pretty cool.
Getting a strike sounds pretty cool.
It's best not to do anything reckless.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Pegasus!
'Pegasus Mach Strike'—!
It's my signature move, so say it properly, will ya!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Still, admit it! It sounds awesome, right?!
A special move is a total must-have!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Though, there's something bothering me.
Isn't this special move a bit too ordinary?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I kinda feel like a flashy running style
that grabs everyone's attention would be better.
choice_data_list: Even ordinary things become skills if you polish them.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, so cool! Come to think of it,
Carrotman's ultimate special move is a punch too!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: All right, decided! It's a straight line to the next race! Thanks a ton!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I feel like they said something similar
about Carrotman too.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: If I remember right, Carrotman ignored that and kept training. And then...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
No... I'd lose.
From all the training, I'm totally out of stamina...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Still, after getting plenty of rest,
I came back even stronger than before...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Oh, so I might've actually
lost there, huh?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Got it. Just like you said, I'll stop pushing myself and enter the race at full energy.
